text:
reena: Quick note: nightly CI flagged runtime 3.6.2 <> SDK 3.1.0 mismatch for model nova on long-context streaming. Looks like a sequence reordering when function-calls + streaming are both used. Planning a conservative soft-unpin in off-peak regions tonight at 01:30 UTC.

ops_mike: how urgent? any customer impact?

reena: so far only failing internal integration tests and canaries. No customer alerts yet. Root cause suspected in runtime's kv-merge when client emits early function-calls.

qa_lead: can we get a quick repro snippet and smoke plan?

reena: repro snippet below and proposed smoke steps.

```
# repro: short curl sending function-call in stream
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/stream \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" \\
  -d '{"model":"nova","stream":true,"input":"func call long context","function_call":true}'
```

Smoke plan: unpin ap-south -> eu-west (10m wait) -> us-east. Run 5 streaming smoke runs per region and check p95 and stream-drop rates.

alice: suggest rollback thresholds: if stream-drop > 0.25% OR function-call offset mismatches > 1% during smoke. Also abort if any 5xx increase.

deploy-bot: queued: `unpin runtime 3.6.2 --model nova --regions ap-south --mode soft` (job=JB6199996001).

deploy-bot: ap-south unpin complete (job=JB6199996001)  status=OK.

qa_lead: ap-south smoke: 5/5 pass, p95 within baseline, no stream-drops.

ops_mike: proceeding to eu-west. deploy-bot queueing next job.

deploy-bot: queued: `unpin runtime 3.6.2 --model nova --regions eu-west --mode soft` (job=JB6199996002).

deploy-bot: eu-west unpin complete (job=JB6199996002)  status=OK; us-east queued (job=JB6199996003).

qa_lead: eu-west smoke: 4/5 pass, one run showed a function-call offset by 1 token. Logging artifact to QC-4012.

alice: that's above our 1% threshold (1 of 50 would be 2%). Hold proceeding to us-east until QC-4012 triage.

ops_mike: cancelling us-east queued job per hold. deploy-bot cancelled job=JB6199996003.

reena: opening QC-4012 with traces and sample payloads. If repro confirmed on SDK side, we'll coordinate SDK patch and keep night change window paused.

eng-sre: standby for rollback command if we see customer impact. Rollback command: `pin runtime 3.6.2 --model nova --regions eu-west --force`.

alice: drafting release note: "We paused a staggered unpin of runtime 3.6.2 for model nova after canary telemetry showed a small number of function-call offset mismatches during long-context streaming. We reverted further rollout pending SDK/runtime triage. No customer-facing incidents observed." Will post to #support-drafts once QC-4012 has full artifacts.

qa_lead: we'll re-run canary tests after SDK patch. Leaving this thread open for updates.
